All wings will have their own executive and this executive will have a total of 45 members.

President - 1, Vice President - 4 (total 9 Vice Presidents in Swarajya Sena), General Secretary - 1, Co-Secretary - 3, Organization Minister - 1, Co-Organization Minister - 5, Treasurer - 1, Office In-charge - 2, Publicity Secretary - 9.
This form of wing will be applicable in Central Committee, State, Division, District, Block and Ward Committee.
Elections and committees will be formed at the provincial, divisional, Lok Sabha, Assembly, Panchayat and ward levels.
There will be election of President, General Secretary and Treasurer at all levels.

Special Note: The tenure of all the executives will be three years. That is, elections for the organization will be held every three years. These elections will be held every three years between March and May.
The National President and National General Secretary have the right to nominate any person (who is a member of Sarvjan Sanatan Party) to any post at all levels.
No wing is independent and will work under the guidance of the President and General Secretary of the parent executive of its level.
All wings are authorized for organization expansion and membership campaigns. But no one has the right to make any wrong statement, protest or contest elections.

Bank accounts will be opened at national, provincial, divisional and assembly levels. The accounts will be operated with the signatures of the concerned President, General Secretary and Treasurer (three people).

Withdrawal of any amount without a clear proposal and reason comes under the category of embezzlement. An audit will be conducted with complete details, which will be made public and will also be sent to the Election Commission.
(05) Information and Quorum of the Meeting
At least 15 days' notice for national and state meetings, and 7 days' prior notice for Block, Panchayat and Ward meetings.
Presence of 60 percent of members will be considered as quorum. The proposal, date and signature should be mentioned in the meeting register.
The Constitution will be amended with the consent of 70 percent of the people in the National Executive meeting.
The elected President and General Secretary will have the prerogative to run the organization.
An inquiry committee on any dispute will be formed by the central leadership.

The final decision on the dispute will be taken by the National Committee under the guidance of Shankaracharya Ji. Devendra Kumar Pandey is the leader of this party, which is a permanent post and cannot be abolished in any way.
(19) A Parliamentary Board of 9 people will take important decisions.
(20) The election manifesto will be prepared after communicating with all sections (experts, journalists, farmers, doctors, etc.).
(21) The star campaigner list for the election campaign will be prepared with the consent of the National President and the National General Secretary.

The contesting candidate will have to give an affidavit that they will follow the instructions of the party. If they violate the instructions of the party, the party will have the right to declare the election void and terminate their membership of the House.
There can be a lifetime ban on contesting elections.
